searchText: Who should we make sure is there at the EOA breakout? - 3074 champion (<@543900561460822016>?) - 5806 champion (<@278099318647422977> ?) - 7553 champion (<@415548822983278593> <@489256758989029405>?) - 4337 champion (<@727296082484265073>?) - A few wallet devs (<@689161464829050960>, suggestions?) - A few contract devs ( <@695340005505106091>, suggestions?) When is that happening ? Ideally next week, and probably needs to happen before Feb 29th if we want a chance of including something in Prague 🙂 Some potential times without other protocol calls, please emoji-react on those that would work for you: 1️⃣ Feb 20 14 UTC 2️⃣ Feb 21 15 UTC 3️⃣ Feb 23 14 UTC ~~4️⃣ Feb 23 15 UTC~~ 5️⃣ Feb 26 15 UTC 6️⃣ Feb 27 14 UTC 7️⃣ Feb 28 14 UTC (cutting it close...!)
